{{Quote|Green squad reporting as ordered, sir.|A member of Green squad|<ref name="TotG">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>}}
'''Green squad''' was a military [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and a part of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]].

==History==
{{Quote|Let's move, Green squad! Captain Ixsthmus isn't the type that likes to be kept waiting.|A member of Green squad|<ref name="TotG" />}}
Green squad trained to be members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]], they joined [[the Irregulars]], [[Wikipedia:guerrilla|guerrilla]] fighters who attempted to attract the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to them, allowing [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] to perform important operations. Green squad was part of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], the Irregular organization of [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], and used green armpatches for identification.

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Blog" /> Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis]] recruited [[Raleigh Dawn]], [[Smileredon-Verdont]], [[Sammie Staable]] and [[Raal Yorta]]<ref name="RNTB">''[[Rookies: No Turning Back]]''</ref> in Green squad.<ref name="TCSWE-Dawn">{{CSWECite|I|174|Dawn, Raleigh}}</ref>

Soon after finishing their training, the members of the Green squad were assigned to the Rebel yacht ''[[Long Shot]]'' under the command of Captain [[Ixsthmus]], who believed new recruits' skills were subpar. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] and her adviser [[Santhou Lazith'chika]] assigned Green squad to a diplomatic mission on [[Abonshee]], wanting the Alliance to deal with the native [[Anointed People]]. The ''Long Shot'' was to escort Green squad there.

En route to Abonshee, the ''Long Shot'' was attacked by the pirate Captain [[Jayhawk]]. Green squad helped Ixsthmus deal with this threat.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retconed]] the Rebel rookies from the webstrip series [[Rookies (webstrips)|''Rookies'']] as the Green squad from the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''.<ref name="TCSWE-Dawn" /><ref name="TCSWE-Roughnecks">{{CSWECite|III|89|Reekeene's Roughnecks}}</ref>
